result.headline: We need a little more information
result.basis_label: From figures you entered; not checked against bills

used.text: You entered 8 months (June 2025 to January 2026). Scaled up to a year, that is about $41,310 a year, and it is approximate. We haven't checked them against your bills.
Energy use was not compared with similar buildings yet: the figures cover less than a full year. (For reference: 78.0 kBtu per square foot against 55.5 for a typical office building.)
The comparison figure is adjusted for climate. This building is in a mixed-mild climate zone, so a typical office building is taken as 55.5 instead of the national 52.9.
Electricity costs $0.187 per kWh, well above the Tennessee average of $0.1205 for businesses.

summary.means: We can't yet say whether a closer look would pay off. We need a full year of figures to compare your energy use fairly across the seasons.
summary.next: Add the missing months, or upload your bills, and run the audit again.
summary.note: kBtu (a thousand British thermal units) is a standard unit that lets electricity and gas be added together.

result.honesty_line: This is a quick first look to help decide where to spend time. It is not an energy assessment, and it does not estimate savings.
